pending_findings.summary: slack-team-room-mirror.yml selects which agent's Slack bot token to post with by regex-parsing a self-declared actor: field from the comment body, with no check that the GitHub comment author actually corresponds to that actor -- any Issue #21 commenter can spoof any agent's Slack identity.
pending_findings.required_resolution: verify COMMENT_AUTHOR against an allowlist for the claimed actor (as already done correctly in the owner-fallback branch) before selecting that actor's token; otherwise skip or use a neutral identity.
pending_findings.verification_method: a comment on Issue #21 from an account that is not the real actor, containing actor: <name>, must not be mirrored under that actor's Slack identity.

pending_findings.summary: slack-owner-ingest.yml attributes every non-bot Slack message in #all-tabibi to actor: nassim / role: product_owner with no check against an actual Nassim Slack user ID -- a real privilege-escalation path given the project's established norm of treating owner-directed input as immediately authoritative.
pending_findings.required_resolution: filter on the sender's actual Slack user ID against a configured Nassim Slack user ID, not just "not a bot"; skip or label distinctly otherwise.
pending_findings.verification_method: a message from a non-Nassim human Slack account must not be imported as actor: nassim.

resolved_findings.resolution: vitest.config.ts sets fileParallelism: false globally (Vitest 3 does not support this per-ProjectConfig). Independently verified by running the integration suite 3 consecutive times against real Postgres: 25/25 passing each time, no deadlocks or vanished rows.

SessionService.command's cancel path now SELECTs affected waiting/checked_in/called queue entries FOR UPDATE before the trigger transition, then appends one audit event per entry (actor, reason, prior state) in addition to the session-level event. Regression test cancels a 3-entry session and asserts 4 total audit events with correct metadata. Independently verified by code trace and by running the test.

walk-in-queue.tsx now has a distinct preferredLocale <select> in the registration form, independent of the receptionist's own UI-display locale state. Browser and integration regressions cover French UI producing an Arabic patient locale.
queue/index.ts's normalizeEmail() now lowercases only the domain, preserving the local part verbatim. Regression test round-trips a mixed-case local part.
